top_choice_rationale: P002 pairs the optical lattice clock (Katori, Ye), the best-confirmed and most cleanly attributed achievement on the slate, with the discovery of the diffuse high-energy astrophysical neutrino flux at IceCube. The flux is established well above five sigma in several independent channels, and Halzen's role as originator of the cubic-kilometre concept is the least contested individual credit in the programme. The pair gives a discovery element that the clock alone lacks and sits apart from the recent circuit-prize and prior frequency-metrology awards. I hold the one-name IceCube credit less firmly than the clock, so P001 is a close second.
recusal_note: Documented PAMELA, Fermi-LAT and balloon/gamma-ray instrument experience gives general astroparticle proximity to the IceCube field, but no specific collaboration with the proposed laureates is apparent from the profile; as chair I note it, though the simulation does not adjudicate recusals.
